name: Romsdalseggen ridge
why: A ridge high over the Romsdal valley with the Trollveggen wall opposite, ending with the Rampestreken platform above Åndalsnes.
book: Free: the Norwegian right to roam (allemannsretten). Paid parking at the trailhead. Bus from Åndalsnes to Vengedalen in summer. Or Rampestreken only by the Romsdalen gondola.
dangers: Weather turns fast: fog, rain and wind even in July. Check yr.no and turn back in fog.
